entries.title: Use exact current sources before card review
entries.summary: Card reviews must begin from exact current card data and current project terminology; memory, stale matrices, and rendered cards are secondary evidence only.

entries.title: Review faction-locking effects against shared-pool needs
entries.summary: Every faction-lock recommendation must examine what the Neutral pool loses and whether the card duplicates or interacts incorrectly with the destination faction.

entries.title: Review logs record decisions, not stale source metadata
entries.summary: Decision logs should preserve approved outcomes and future watch items, not repeat superseded source classifications as though they remain current.

entries.title: Audit every Gauntlet conversation into durable repository records
entries.summary: Cross-chat memory is not an authority. Finalized, rejected, deferred, and superseded discussion must be extracted from the exported conversations and made durable in the repository.

entries.title: Record approved changes in governing sources before derivatives
entries.summary: Approved changes must be written into the governing source and then propagated to canonical data, print, tools, implementation, and tests.

entries.title: Keep project copyright explicit and do not add a permissive license
entries.summary: Release packages and repository material retain explicit copyright/use language; no permissive open-source license is implied for game content.
